criteria.passes: for each orbit separately: 29 Oct 2026 (reference, wet) -> 10 Nov 2026 (dry), identical grid
criteria.groups: B = pixels inside the 508 brightened fields (track-151 outlines carried onto the orbit's grid by position); F = surrounding farmland: pixels in no changed field, not urban, darker than -5 dB HH on both track-151 dates; U = Ceyhan urban control. All pixels: valid on both dates (mask 1..254, exception mask 768, gamma0 > 0), inside the track-151 analysis area, 500 m from invalid pixels
criteria.metric: dB = 10*log10(sum gamma0_10Nov / sum gamma0_29Oct) over a group (pooled linear HH). Relative change = dB(B) - dB(F)
criteria.Q1_pooled: relative change <= -1.0 dB (the brightened fields darken at least 1 dB more than the farmland around them)
criteria.Q2_most_fields: at least two thirds of the brightened fields (those with >= 25 pixels on the orbit's grid) darken more than the surrounding farmland (field dB < dB(F))
criteria.Q3_control: urban control |dB(U)| <= 0.5 dB, otherwise the orbit is not comparable -> inconclusive
criteria.verdict_per_orbit: Q1 and Q2 met -> CONFIRMED (wet soil); relative change >= 0 -> REFUTED (stayed bright: roughness/ploughing); otherwise MIXED; Q3 failed -> INCONCLUSIVE
void_if: the 10 Nov granule for that orbit is missing, not VALIDATED, or not on the identical grid

rain before the 10 Nov pass: NASA POWER >= 10 mm over 7-10 Nov at 35.8E 37.0N. (Known at lock: 0.0 mm on each of 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11 Nov, and NASA SMAP 0.134 m3/m3 on 10 Nov AM, so the weather condition is already met.)
